entities.summary: Zbigniew Preisner is a Polish film score composer, best known for his work with film director Krzysztof Kieślowski. He is the recipient of the Gold Medal for Merit to Culture – Gloria Artis as well as the Knight's Cross of the Order of Polonia Restituta. He is a member of the French Film Academy. Zbigniew Preisner was a composers & musicians from Bielsko-Biała (b. 1955-05-20, Bielsko-Biała). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
